digest.component_or_area: LLM verifier model selection and resolution
propositions: Three independent verifier code paths use equality tests against DEFAULT_MODEL to decide whether to downgrade from frontier to standard class, causing silent fallback to framework default when operator configures a non-default provider.

Verifier resolution must consolidate on a single reserved-word vocabulary (trivial/standard/frontier) resolved through resolve_model_string, eliminating provider-qualified id matching that fails against Bedrock model identifiers.

Code-review.yaml verify step declares no model key and carries temperature:0 for determinism, but the setting never takes effect because the step runs on frontier model; moving to standard class makes the declared determinism real.
resolve_model must be wired to call resolve_model_string for class names while preserving byte-identical backward compatibility for literal model ids passed by existing workflow YAML.

The completion verifier and plan-review xcheck callers (_verifier_cfg at xcheck.py:198 and xcheck.py:336) must resolve the standard class through their real call paths, not in isolation, to prevent silent leakage of frontier model when operator changes provider.
